description: A resource's id: a name, never the resource's URI or a path. 1 to 128 of the letters `A`–`Z` and `a`–`z`, the digits, `_` and `-`. It is one segment of a URL and one name in a file system, and it is held to that wherever it enters: a gateway refuses a payload that carries anything else. How one is made is no part of the rule. `__system__` is the one that names no resource: the scope events about the knowledge base itself are logged under.
